jobs.title: AVP, Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
You have a clear vision of where your career can go. And we have the leadership to help you get there. At CNA, we strive to create a culture in which people know they matter and are part of something important, ensuring the abilities of all employees are used to their fullest potential.

The Assistant Vice President, Data & Analytics is responsible for leading CNA Canada's analytics strategy and delivery, ensuring data-driven insights support business performance, decision-making, and strategic priorities. This role serves as the primary liaison between business leaders, Technology, and Global Data & Analytics teams to translate business needs into actionable analytics solutions and measurable business outcomes.

The AVP is accountable for analytics prioritization, roadmap development, stakeholder engagement, adoption, and value realization while promoting a culture of data-driven decision making across the organization.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Performs a combination of duties in accordance with departmental guidelines:

Develop and execute the Canada Data & Analytics roadmap aligned with business strategy and enterprise priorities.
Build strong relationships with business leaders to understand priorities, identify opportunities, and ensure analytics solutions address key business challenges.
Lead intake, prioritization, and governance of analytics requests, balancing business value, resource capacity, and enterprise alignment.
Define, monitor, and communicate key business metrics, performance indicators, and analytics outcomes.
Partner closely with DASH, Global Data & Analytics, and business stakeholders to align Canada's analytics strategy, priorities, and outcomes with enterprise objectives while ensuring local business and regulatory requirements are effectively addressed.
Lead the adoption, maturation, and utilization of the enterprise Analytics Spoke Network model within Canada, ensuring alignment with global analytics standards, operating models, and delivery practices while addressing unique Canadian business needs and priorities.

Champion a Global approach, leveraging existing enterprise tools, data assets, and solutions before building locally.
Drive adoption and value realization of analytics products, dashboards, reporting solutions, and data-driven insights.
Lead the development and application of advanced analytics, data science, predictive modeling, and research methodologies to identify opportunities, improve business performance, and support strategic decision-making.
Foster a culture of experimentation, evidence-based decision making, and analytical rigor through the application of statistical analysis, research techniques, and data modeling practices.
Guide the evolution of Canada's analytics capabilities beyond reporting and business intelligence toward predictive, prescriptive, and AI-enabled decision support.
Provide strategic guidance on data, analytics, reporting, automation, and AI opportunities that improve business performance and operational efficiency.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Canadian analytics team while effectively leveraging and managing global analytics partners, shared services, and enterprise capabilities to deliver best-in-class analytics outcomes for Canada.
Establish an operating model that balances local accountability with enterprise collaboration to maximize value realization and delivery effectiveness.
Serve as an active member of the Global Analytics Leadership Team, contributing to enterprise strategy, capability development, governance, prioritization, and the advancement of analytics practices across the organization.
Ensure effective stakeholder communication, change management, and transparency from request through delivery.

Reporting Relationship

Typically VP or Above, CNA Canada

Skills, Knowledge & Capabilities

Strong knowledge of data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, and data-driven decision making.
Ability to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and actionable insights.
Experience developing analytics roadmaps, prioritizing work, and managing stakeholder demand.
Strong business acumen with the ability to influence decisions across multiple business functions.
Excellent relationship management, communication, and presentation skills.
Proven leadership capability with experience developing high-performing teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and performance measurement frameworks.
Deep understanding of data science, statistical modeling, advanced analytics, AI-enabled decision support, performance measurement frameworks, and modern analytics platforms.

Advanced education in Data Science, Analytics, Research, Statistics, or a related field is considered an asset.
Minimum 10 years of experience in Data & Analytics, Business Intelligence, Product Management, Technology, or a related discipline.
Minimum 7 years of leadership experience leading teams and strategic initiatives.
Experience partnering with senior business leaders to define and deliver data and analytics solutions.
Experience developing performance metrics, reporting frameworks, and analytical insights that support business decisions.
Insurance, financial services, or other data-intensive industry experience preferred.
Experience with data visualization and analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, ThoughtSpot, or similar tools preferred

jobs.title: Director, Data Operations & Analytics
jobs.description:
About Cover Genius

Cover Genius is the global infrastructure for embedded protection. Active in over 60 countries and all 50 US States, we protect the customers of the world’s largest digital companies, including Klarna, Revolut, Stripe, Priceline, Agoda, Booking.com, Turkish Airlines, Tongcheng Travel, eBay, and Uber, with seamless, end-to-end experiences. Cover Genius has protected more than 73M customers globally across 240M policies with USD $3.2BN in gross written sales.

Coming off a stellar year with 40% YoY revenue growth and a recent $100M capital raise, putting our valuation at $1.9BN, we are accelerating into our next phase of growth. As part of our team, you’ll help drive our AI-first roadmap, developing hyper-personalization engines, agentic distribution, and automated claims infrastructure, while building the scalable technology powering the fast-growing $70B embedded protection market.

Our people are:
Accountable, customer-obsessed, collaborative, driven

Our people are not:
Passive, defensive, siloes-driven, hesitant

About The Role

Cover Genius is entering its next phase of growth, and this role is the chance to build the data function that takes us there. You won't be inheriting a finished org chart, you'll be designing how data operations and analytics work as one function: a single, trusted set of definitions for the metrics that matter, and a team the business turns to first.

This is a key contributor role within our data domain, and one of the driving forces behind delivering our data vision. You'll work closely with data engineering, data science, product, and actuaries to turn that roadmap into real value for the business, our customers, and our partners.

You'll lead two teams, one running data operations and analytics, one running merchant partner & regulatory reporting, and you'll sit as the bridge between the business and our technical data teams, translating business questions into asks for data engineering, data science, and our AI adoption function, and making sure what they build actually lands with the people who need it. This also means giving actuaries and other insurance specialists access to data they don't currently have, so they can do their own in-depth analysis rather than working from a finished report.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Data Operations & Analytics Function: lead both the data operations/analytics team and the merchant & partner reporting team, setting priorities that answer real business questions rather than growing the metric count for its own sake.
Business Ownership of the Semantic Layer: define what our core metrics mean and where the source of truth lives (GWP, revenue, claims ratio, and others), and get business sign-off on the logic behind them. When a metric doesn't exist yet, this team builds it.
Data Governance Documentation: own the governance framework behind the semantic layer, metric ownership, definition standards, and change control, so metric trust doesn't depend on someone remembering how a number was built.
Internal BI Ownership: own the internal BI tool end to end and drive adoption across the business. We're the team that gets other teams building their own dashboards and insight, not waiting on a ticket, including training people how to use the tool properly. Where a team can't build what they need themselves in their own domain, we build it for them.
Merchant & Partner Reporting: own reporting accuracy, reconciliation, and regulatory reporting for our merchant and partner relationships, and build the operating rhythm that catches issues before they reach a partner or a regulator.
OKR Instrumentation: translate business and domain OKRs into accurate, trusted data tracking, and make sure every domain has the data assets it needs to measure its own progress.
Drive Data Use Across the Business: look for where data, AI, and automation can remove manual work or replace ad hoc spreadsheets with real systems, ahead of being asked, including automating workflows within our own team.
Team Leadership & Development: grow a team that spans junior analyst to manager, build career paths, and raise data literacy across the business so leaders trust the numbers and ask sharper questions.

Skills And Experience

10+ years in data or reporting operations, including 4+ years leading managers, not just individual contributors.
A track record of fixing unclear ownership and accountability gaps across technical and business teams, in addition to running your own team well.
Fluency in modern data stacks; dbt, BigQuery, semantic layers, BI tools.
Experience defining metrics and governance, what a number means, who owns it, where it lives, in a business with more than one data team.
Comfortable presenting to C-suite and cross-functional leadership on data strategy and risk.
Insurance, insurtech, fintech, or another regulated, data-heavy industry is a plus, particularly experience supporting actuarial or underwriting teams, or running fraud/risk analytics.
Experience building a roadmap with dependencies across multiple technical and business teams, with the project management discipline to scope, sequence, and track it to completion.
Experience running cross-team coordination as a discipline: async updates, meetings with a clear owner, and open items that actually get closed out rather than left in a thread.

Proficiencies And Attributes

Moves fluently between an executive conversation on strategy and a technical one with data engineering, without needing to own the technical call.
Takes ownership of unresolved problems, unclear owners, poor request quality, broken reporting, instead of waiting for someone else to claim them.
Commercially minded enough to know which metrics actually matter to the business.
A people leader who manages managers and invests in a team spanning multiple levels.
Raises the bar on data literacy and requests quality across the whole business, not just within the team.
Understands the business drivers behind each team's numbers, not just the numbers themselves."
Builds trust and alignment through influence, not authority, earning buy-in by showing people the shared benefit rather than asking them to comply.
Takes an ambiguous, cross-system problem and turns it into a clear framework and a workable solution, then operates independently enough to scope and drive it without waiting to be told how.

🤔 Why Cover Genius?

At Cover Genius, We Create Magic By Turning The Archaic Into The Extraordinary. We Take One Of The World’s Oldest And Most Complex Industries And Reinvent It With World-class Technology. Cover Genius Doesn’t Just Disrupt Legacy Insurance; We Make The Impossible Feel Effortless.Our Operating Principles Guide Our Mission

Make today matter: We deliver with urgency and excellence. We act decisively, move with intention, and hold a high bar.
Act with accountability: We own our commitments and take pride in delivering results that move us forward.
Grow together: We are a collective of curious minds. We learn from wins and setbacks, share knowledge generously, and elevate each other every day.
Inspire Each Other: We push each other to think bigger and pull together to go further.
Champion Our Customers: We lead with empathy and center the customer, turning complex disruptions into seamless moments of trust.
Flexible Work Environment - Our teams are hybrid. We work from home on a Wednesday and Thursday and attend the office on Monday, Tuesday and Friday with flexibility around start/finish times.
Don't just take our word for it - hear about our culture straight from our people here: story time.

Ready to make an impact?
If you’re looking for a place where you’ll be challenged, trusted, and empowered, we’d love to meet you.

The Legal & Privacy Stuff

Cover Genius promotes diversity and inclusivity. We don't tolerate discrimination, demeaning treatment of anyone, or harassment due to race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may collect, store, and process your personal data for recruitment purposes. To ensure a fair evaluation, we may use AI to assist in sorting applications, but all final decisions are made by our hiring team and no candidate dispositions are automated. We will keep your information on file for three years from the date of your application. For detailed information about how we handle your data and our use of AI, please review our full Privacy Policy .

jobs.title: Director, Data Science
jobs.description:
At Gore Mutual, we’ve always set ourselves apart as a modern mutual that does good. Now, we’re proudly building on that legacy to transform our company—and our industry—for the better.

Effective January 1, 2026, Gore has joined Beneva—the country’s largest mutual insurance company—as part of its Property & Casualty operations in Ontario and Western Canada. During 2026, Gore will combine its operations with Unica Insurance, Beneva’s Ontario-based subsidiary specializing in niche commercial and personal insurance, creating a stronger, more diversified mutual insurer with greater scale and long-term stability.

Every decision and investment remains anchored in long-term benefits to customers, members, and communities. Come join us.

This leadership position requires a unique combination of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and innovation to leverage data and advanced analytics solutions that drive business growth, enhance operational efficiency, and ensure regulatory compliance. This role will lead a team of data scientists focused on delivering measured value through AI/ML use cases that span across all aspects of Gore. You will lead and mentor a team of high performing data scientists and shape our growth strategy through empirical studies and experimentation. This role is resourceful, analytically rigorous, with extensive experience leading data science teams and a passion for solving product problems.

This role is a mix of consulting know-how (problem solving, thought leadership, communication), analytical proficiency in statistics, data science and machine learning, agentic workflows, and, when required, hands-on proficiency in SQL/Python programming, visualization methods and technologies, and data engineering / infrastructure.

This role is responsible for leveraging data science to assess risks, improve underwriting, detect fraud, and optimize pricing models while unlocking valuable insights, optimize processes, and inform decision-making. By implementing advanced analytics and ensuring data integrity, this role enables the organization to make informed decisions, streamline operations, and ultimately provide better coverage and services to policyholders while managing risks effectively.

What will you do :

Model Development & Deployment

Managing a data science project from end-to-end, including collaborating with partners and stakeholders to understand the business problem, obtaining data, defining an experimental design, setting up a model building pipeline, overseeing a team of data scientists to build necessary models, and working with a team of developers to implement models and managing a monitoring process
Developing and maintaining predictive models using advanced ML/AI techniques. Building Supervised and unsupervised learning models LLM workflows and agents.
overseeing the development of analytical products and machine learning models, AI models, LLM workflows and agents, building and enabling analytics infrastructure including production model deployment, as well as Non Prod experimentation, deployment and testing
Define metrics to measure the impact of AI initiatives on business outcomes.

Model Maintenance, Governance & Validation

Design detailed validation plans and perform quantitative, conceptual and technical assessment of models; Discuss and effectively communicate validation observations and findings with teams.
Accountable for the integration of AI solutions, application deployment in production including, app health, resiliency, performance, security, enterprise data management standards, ethical and privacy standards
Continuously monitor and improve the performance of AI models, ensuring their accuracy, reliability, scalability, and ethical application. Includes optimization of our end-to-end machine learning pipelines, scaling, automating, and monitoring our predictive models and pipelines.
Strategic direction on compliance for the design, development, and implementation of AI models into operational workflows, including helping draft and review the procedures that support a compliance system. Responsibilities include guiding AI teams with project planning, system architecture, risk management, verification & validation, and continuous monitoring.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Lead a team of data scientists to develop, plan, and execute multiple analytical projects creating and delivering high quality AI and analytical solutions across a broad spectrum of projects and business lines.
Being a change champion and help the business conduct business problem opportunities and assessment identifying revenue generation and cost saving opportunities, developing proposals and make recommendations for model usage to the downstream partners.
Advocates and advances modern, Agile solution delivery practices, great design, engineering and organizational practices, challenging the team to utilize creative thinking to modify or select the most suitable procedure/approach to solve a business problem balancing complexity and value.
Driving change within team and across broader Data & Analytics the importance of learning our business and the respective to help aid in our building the best solutions – be a business expert.
Guide project teams in synthesizing analytical findings for consumption by internal analytical clients and business executives.Excellent communicator who is able to convey complex information in an understandable, compelling, and persuasive manner to non-technical clients and executives and junior data scientists

Strategy

Creates the advanced analytics strategy, ensuring technology solutions comply with enterprise AI/ML standards, model governance and model risk standards, and AI Ethics, Fairness and Bias related control practices
Conceptualize, design and execute an ambitious data science, ML and AI (e.g., LLM and agentic) roadmap
Own the business outcomes, KPIs and deliverables of that roadmap working across stakeholders
Identify and define new strategic ML opportunities and work with cross functional teams to understand business requirements and guide the team to provide data-driven solutions, improving how we do data collection, storage, experimentation and analysis.

Research & Innovation

Stay current with the latest advancements in Agentic/AI/ML solutions and evaluate their applicability to Gore
Develop strategic relationships and partnerships with the startup, academia, and industry ecosystem to garner mindshare and learnings.
Foster a culture of innovation by encouraging research, experimentation and exploration of novel AI techniques

What skills will you need:

Minimum Master’s degree, Ph.D. Highly preferred in a technology/analytical field such as Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Data Science, Operations Research, Machine Learning, Engineering, or other relevant scientific fields
Over 10 years of expereince with a minimum 8 years of relevant professional experience, 4+ years of leading a team in developing and implementing AI/ML solutions (predictive, prescriptive, ML etc.)with an excellent understanding of the underlying Statistical, Machine Learning theory, and Predictive Modeling Lifecycle
Extensive experience in building, deploying, and managing production-ready generative models and machine learning models.
Foundational and applied knowledge of statistical analyses, data science, and machine learning including, but not limited to descriptive, inferential, or causal statistics, predictive and forecast modeling, optimization modeling, NLP, LLM and agentic workflows and A/B testing methods
Deep expertise in developing and maintaining predictive models using advanced ML/AI techniques. Proficiency in building Supervised learning models [ (classification and regression) – tree-based (Random Forest, Stochastic Gradient Boosting and eXtreme Gradient Boosting, Decision Trees, Extra Trees, Regularized Greedy Forests), Generalized Linear Models, Discriminant models (LDA, MDA, FDA and QDA)], and Unsupervised learning models (Isolation Forest, Clustering algorithms), Reinforcement learning, LLMs, agentic systems, graph and network analysis
Deep knowledge and hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AgenticAI, including experience with MLOps to build end-to-end pipelines and deploy models in production
Experience in building Deep neural networks (MLP, CNN, RNN, GRUs, and LSTMs) and use of AI/Deep Learning frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, CNTK, and Keras
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.
Proficiency in SQL, Python, Pandas, Numpy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch etc.
Excellent problem-solving skills, strategic thinking, and a proactive approach to challenges.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to a non-technical audience and influence top-tier executives. Proven ability to translate complex data findings into actionable business strategies and drive business growth
Deep understanding of the complexities and tradeoffs of leveraging/deploying ML/AI at scale
An ideal candidate will have a passion for AI/ML and to foster a team of AI/ML and business experts and increase the data and analytics literacy with the business. They have an analytical mindset, be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, detail oriented and have desire to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment while influencing business performance through insights.

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Leads and oversees the Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture team globally within Global Technology & Enterprise Platforms (GTEP), ensuring infrastructure strategies, target-state architectures, standards, patterns, and technology roadmaps are defined and maintained in alignment with business objectives, enterprise architecture principles, regulatory obligations, resilience expectations, and the Bank’s risk appetite.

This role is accountable for defining infrastructure strategy and architectural guardrails across core infrastructure domains. Leads the team responsible for target-state architecture, platform strategy, and standards, enabling consistent, service-based delivery through approved architecture patterns and certified Engineering service offerings, driving technology transformation and roadmap execution.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:

Leads and oversees the Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture team, providing direction, prioritization, and accountability across infrastructure domains
Builds and develops a high-performing team of domain leads and senior architects through coaching, mentorship, and succession planning
Establishes clear expectations for architecture quality, standards adherence, and engagement with Solution Architecture, Engineering, and Governance teams
Drives a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement aligned with the Bank’s values and risk culture
Owns enterprise-wide infrastructure strategy, target-state architectures, and multi-year roadmaps across infrastructure domains (Network, Data Center, Hosting, Unified Communications, and Enterprise Platforms)
Drives technology transformation, platform modernization, and simplification aligned to business strategy and enterprise architecture direction
Translates enterprise strategy into actionable architecture direction for Solution Architecture and Engineering teams
Leads the definition and lifecycle management of infrastructure standards, reference architectures, patterns, and architectural guardrails
Drives platform standardization, rationalization, and introduction of new capabilities across infrastructure domains

Provides overall architectural authority across infrastructure domains and acts as escalation point for complex decisions and cross-domain conflicts

Why join us?

The IESO is committed to ensuring Ontario’s electricity system meets the province’s needs today and into the future. We are charged with purpose
, delivering reliable, affordable, and sustainable electricity for homes, businesses, and communities across the province. We are energized to grow
, embracing opportunities to shape the future of a dynamic and evolving energy sector while advancing our careers. We are powered by teamwork
, supported by diverse and passionate colleagues who foster respect, celebrate successes, and thrive on shared achievements. At the IESO, it’s not just what we do— it’s who we are!

Who We Are

Our central role includes managing the provincial power grid in real-time, overseeing and evolving Ontario’s electricity market, engaging with government, municipalities and Indigenous communities, and planning for Ontario’s future electricity needs. Our employees play a key role in driving grid innovation, protecting the system from threats, advancing the province’s energy conservation programs, and forecasting and procuring the electricity resources we’ll need in the decades to come.

This is a non-unionized position that falls within the Corporate Relations, Engagement and Strategy business unit.

What Makes This Role Exciting

The energy sector is rapidly evolving, offering exciting new opportunities for those who want to make a difference.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the organization's strategic direction and drive initiatives that have enterprise-wide impact. Working closely with senior leaders, the role influences corporate strategy, oversees its implementation, and leads high-profile CEO and organizational priorities. The position offers a rare combination of strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and people leadership, allowing you to see ideas progress from concept to measurable results.

For someone who enjoys solving complex challenges and creating organizational alignment, this role sits at the center of the organization's most important priorities.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you’ll make a meaningful impact by contributing to the IESO team and supporting the electricity needs of the province through:

Leading the development and socialization of the Corporate Strategy, working in close partnership with Directors and senior leaders. Coordinate strategic planning activities, stakeholder engagement, and supporting research, and develop recommendations for Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Board consideration and approval.
Leading the development of the Strategy Implementation Plan, including prioritization of strategic initiatives, milestones, performance measures, and implementation approaches. Facilitate engagement with business areas and provide recommendations to support ELT decision-making and approval.
Overseeing enterprise-wide monitoring, measurement, and reporting of progress against strategic objectives. Establish and implement reporting approaches, assess organizational performance against strategic commitments, identify emerging risks and issues, and provide insights and recommendations to support leadership decision-making.
Coordinating and aligning corporate strategy activities with other enterprise planning functions, including business planning, enterprise risk management, enterprise change, procurement, workforce planning, etc. Identify opportunities to strengthen the Enterprise Planning Framework and recommend improvements that enhance organizational alignment and execution.
Leading the delivery of CEO-sponsored and strategic initiatives, such as ESG framework, organizational alignment reviews, and other corporate priorities. Direct supporting research, analysis, and project activities; oversee external consultants and contractors where required; and develop recommendations arising from initiative outcomes for consideration by the CEO and Executive Leadership Team.
Provide leadership, direction, and coaching to team members, ensuring the effective delivery of corporate strategy, strategy implementation planning, enterprise reporting, and strategic initiatives through clear priorities, performance expectations, and professional development support.

Decision-Making Responsibilities

Contribute to developing the approach, methodology, and stakeholder engagement process for the development of the Corporate Strategy and Strategy Implementation Plan.
Approve research, analysis, and other work products supporting strategy development, implementation planning, and strategic initiatives.
Determine the approach for strategy performance oversight and enterprise reporting.
Lead the selection and management of consultants and contractors supporting strategy or strategic initiative work, in accordance with organizational policies and procurement requirements.
Make decisions related to the coordination, prioritization, and execution of strategic and CEO-sponsored initiatives.

Recommendations

Recommend the Corporate Strategy, developed in collaboration with Directors and key stakeholders, for consideration and approval by the Executive Leadership Team and Board.
Recommend the Strategy Implementation Plan, including strategic priorities, sequencing of work, performance measures, and resource considerations, for Executive Leadership Team approval.
Recommend enhancements to the Enterprise Planning Framework to strengthen alignment across corporate strategy, business planning, enterprise risk management, enterprise change, workforce planning, procurement, and other enterprise functions.
Develop and present recommendations arising from CEO-sponsored and strategic initiatives, including opportunities, risks, implementation approaches, and organizational impacts, for consideration and approval by the CEO and Executive Leadership Team.
Provide strategic advice and recommendations to senior leadership on organizational performance, emerging issues, risks, trends, and opportunities identified through strategy oversight, reporting, and environmental scanning activities.

Role Requirements

Our team consists of experts from diverse backgrounds, each bringing their unique perspectives and skills.

To Succeed In This Role, You’ll Need

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Public Policy, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
12-15+ years of progressively senior experience in government relations, public affairs, strategy, policy, or a related function, preferably within the electricity or broader energy sector.
Strong knowledge of the electricity sector, government and regulatory environments, strategic planning and execution, business operations, and financial and budget management.
Proven ability to influence and build relationships with senior leaders, and other internal and external stakeholders.
Exceptional communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to convey complex issues effectively and drive alignment.
Demonstrated success leading, developing, and motivating professional teams while fostering collaboration and delivering strategic outcomes.

How We Support You

From a comprehensive total rewards program to dynamic learning and development opportunities—including job rotations to broaden your expertise—we empower you to define and shape your own success. When you join the IESO, here’s what you can expect:

Best-in-class benefits and long-term support in the form of a defined benefit pension plan.
Work in a dynamic and evolving sector that offers exciting opportunities and the chance to explore new career paths.
Leadership that values meaningful discussions, welcomes feedback, and prioritizes career development.
A strong, inclusive culture and a collaborative team environment with a shared passion for impactful work.
Compensation packages that are regularly reviewed to remain competitive and to best accommodate the diverse needs of our employees.

Deadline

October 29, 2026. For future reference, please save a copy of the job posting as it will no longer be available once the posting closes.

Thank you for your interest in a career at the IESO. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. Please note that the successful candidate must be legally eligible to work in Canada and will be subject to applicable background checks.

IESO will not conduct interviews or offer positions via online, text, chat or social media platforms. We will not gather personal information directly from candidates or potential candidates. Selected candidates will work with our Talent Acquisition team to ensure their application is processed.

The IESO currently has a 3-day in-office work week for applicable roles. Over the course of 2026, the IESO will advance plans to acquire additional office space to accommodate more in-office time. While the timeline for moving to a full 5-day in-office model has not yet been established, we are committed to keeping employees and candidates informed as plans progress and give them as much advance notice as possible to prepare for any changes.

We believe in opportunities for everyone.

At the IESO, we know that achieving great results depends on embracing diversity by attracting, developing, and retaining people from a wide variety of backgrounds. We do this by ensuring our recruitment and advancement policies are fair and equitable, and by creating an accessible and inclusive environment—one that values every team member’s unique skills and experiences and ensures they have the support they need to achieve their potential. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. We’re proud to say we’ve been recognized as a supportive, inclusive employer.

WHAT IS THE OPPORTUNITY?

The role is for Global Data Center engineering lead managing a high performing team of senior engineers responsible for all the networking technology running in the RBC’s global data centers including our cloud presence in Azure and AWS.
